about:
Badger Plastics & Supply Inc was founded in 1984 in Plover, Wisconsin, to address the plastic-related needs of industries across the state. The company began as a supplier of mechanical and industrial plastics and has since added in-house machining, fabrication, and liner installation to its offerings.

The business operates as a full-line distributor of plastic sheets, rods, tubes, and industrial liners while also running a machine shop equipped with a 60" x 120" Haas gantry mill, seven vertical machining centers, three CNC turning centers, manual lathes, manual mills, two CNC panel saws, and plastics welders. It produces custom machined and fabricated parts, urethane molded products, and provides plastic welding, heat bending, and field installation services. The shop handles orders ranging from single prototypes to thousand-piece runs.

Badger Plastics serves foundry and paper industry applications, along with a broad base of industrial customers throughout Wisconsin, eastern Minnesota, and the Upper Peninsula of Michigan. Its traveling sales force covers that tri-state region, while its lining crews have completed installations across the United States.

The company emphasizes personal service and flexibility, promising to do what it takes to meet customer schedules. It cites quick turnaround times, outstanding workmanship, and innovative custom products as key differentiators, backed by a traveling sales team and nationwide liner installation capability.
